shots.description: A man in a navy blazer and a woman with long dark hair walk along the street and up to the entrance of The Portland Hospital for Women and Children. The camera follows them from a low angle until they reach the hospital's name sign on the granite wall.
shots.text_on_screen: THE PORTLAND HOSPITAL for Women and Children; 205 Great Portland Street (partial); road sign: Ring road, Euston, Kilburn, Marylebone

shots.description: A masked consultant in a pink shirt opens the consulting room door and welcomes a masked pregnant woman carrying a handbag into the room for her appointment.

A pregnant woman lies on an examination couch during an ultrasound scan while a clinician in a face mask and blue gloves moves the probe over her bump. Her partner rests a hand on her shoulder as they watch the screen.

A midwife in a white uniform, face mask and glasses attends to a woman lying in bed with her knees raised in a private maternity patient room at The Portland Hospital. The patient is in the soft-focus foreground, with curtained windows and a blue armchair behind.

An empty private patient room on the maternity ward at The Portland Hospital, with a made hospital bed, an overbed table holding a gift bag, and a panda soft toy and champagne bottle on the bedside table. A blue armchair and a bedside lamp sit beside the bed, with medical gas outlets on the wall behind.
Frosted 'Neonatal Unit' lettering on a glass door or screen at the entrance to the neonatal unit at The Portland Hospital, with notices and a yellow door frame behind, shot in soft focus.

A nurse in blue scrubs, mask, glasses and gloves prepares ventilator tubing beside an incubator on the neonatal unit at The Portland Hospital, with patient monitors and a ventilator screen in the background.

A nurse in a navy uniform and face mask sits talking with a couple, a woman in a white top and a man in a dark suit, both masked, in a waiting lounge with leaflet shelves, artwork and plants. The shot is filmed through blurred foreground foliage.

A midwife in a navy uniform carries out an abdominal palpation on a pregnant woman wearing a face mask, who is lying on an examination couch in a maternity consulting room. The shot is framed through a doorway, with a soft-focus wall in the foreground.
A pregnant woman wearing a face mask lies on an examination couch with her bump exposed, talking and gesturing to a staff member seen out of focus in the foreground during an antenatal appointment.

Two staff in navy uniforms work at a bedside on a training manikin in a clinical simulation room, seen through a partly open doorway with a curtain. An anatomical pregnancy model sits on a trolley to the left.
A pregnant woman and her partner walk side by side toward the camera along a city pavement, chatting and laughing, while a passer-by walks past in the background.

Low-angle tracking shot following a man in a navy blazer and a woman in a white top as they walk along a central London pavement past a building colonnade, with a red double-decker bus in the background. A staff member in blue scrubs and a face mask walks past toward the camera.

A masked nurse in blue scrubs and gloves talks with a new mother sitting up in bed in a private maternity room at The Portland Hospital, while a newborn sleeps in a hospital cot in the out-of-focus foreground.
A nurse in blue scrubs, a face mask and gloves fits a blood pressure cuff to the arm of a patient in dark pyjamas, who is sitting up in a private patient room at The Portland Hospital.

A new mother sits up in a hospital bed holding her newborn baby wrapped in a white blanket while the father sits beside her in a blue armchair in a private maternity patient room at The Portland Hospital. The parents talk quietly as the mother looks down at the baby.

Close-up of a sleeping newborn baby swaddled in a white blanket, held by a parent whose dark hair is partly visible at the edge of the frame, with white pillows behind. The baby's face shifts slightly as the camera drifts.
A newborn baby sleeps swaddled in a white blanket while the mother's hand rests on the baby, with a hospital cot visible in the background of a maternity room at The Portland Hospital.
A mother sits in a hospital bed holding her newborn baby while her partner sits beside her in a blue armchair, both smiling and talking in a maternity patient room at The Portland Hospital.
A newborn baby lies swaddled in a white cellular blanket in a hospital cot at The Portland Hospital, eyes partly open and looking around.
